newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia garment producer Mura opens in Sarajevo.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia garment producer Mura opens in Sarajevo.

text.p: Slovenia's biggest garment producer Mura said on Tuesday it had opened a store in the Bosnian capital, Sarajevo, as part of a drive to expand its branches abroad.
Mura opened the store last week in Sarajevo where life has slowly been returning to normal since the end of the 43-month-long war last year.
The company said it expected to increase its turnover to nine million German marks in 1996.

Mura spokesman Ludvik Zrim said the company had also opened a second store in Budapest and had outlets in the Czech Republic and Croatia. Mura sells over 30 percent of its own brand products in the three countries.
"We are planning to open a store in Moscow by the end of this year and in Poland and Slovakia next year," Zrim told Reuters.
Mura employs 6,200 people at its headquarters in Murska Sobota, 200 km (120 miles) northeast of Ljubljana.

Zrim said the company saw great potential for trading with rump Yugoslavia but customs quotas remained an obstacle to serious business. Mura is also negotiating ways of entering the Macedonian market.
Mura's turnover in 1995 was three million marks.
"Our profit was so low that it is not worth mentioning. It was mostly due to high investment costs Mura had in the last two years," Zrim said.
